definitions.explanation: To determine the number of something.

notes:
{数|かぞ}える is an ichidan verb meaning 'to count' or 'to enumerate.'

CONJUGATION:
- {数|かぞ}えます (polite)
- {数|かぞ}えない (negative)
- {数|かぞ}えて (te-form)
- {数|かぞ}えられる (potential)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {数|かぞ}え{切|き}れない: countless, too many to count
- {指折|ゆびお}り{数|かぞ}える: count on fingers (eagerly await)
- {日|ひ}を{数|かぞ}える: count the days
- {人数|にんずう}を{数|かぞ}える: count the number of people

RELATED TERMS:
- {数|かず}: number (noun)
- {数字|すうじ}: numeral, digit
- {計算|けいさん}する: to calculate

NOTE:
The kanji {数|かず/かぞ} appears in both the noun {数|かず} (number) and the verb {数|かぞ}える (to count).
